read_scope: Small protected source/config/snapshot/status files, 54 registered jobs and stop/config metadata, plus stat-only RUN traversal and current system resource metadata. No real GT/graph/base/query/NPZ contents.

stage_summaries.elapsed_scope: Registered command/supervisor elapsed including checks, builds, failed attempts and diagnostics; not complete training cost. Summation can include overlapping nonheavy jobs and is not whole-night wall time.

heavy_intervals.conservative_interval: started_utc through ended_utc recorded by supervisor, including its observation latency

largest_recorded_rusage.meaning: Recorded child rusage.ru_maxrss at command reap; a kernel-accounted command high-water field, not a simultaneous whole-machine memory sum.

largest_polled_RSS.meaning: Largest saved controller polling RSS sample; sampling can miss between-poll peaks and differs from rusage.

deadline.independent_all_proc_identity_scan: Owned by root; not performed or claimed by this reviewer.

run_metadata_walk.scope: Current file metadata before this report write; concurrent root report writes may change totals. No symlink targets followed.

current_resources.scope: Current statvfs/file metadata and /proc/meminfo snapshot, not a bound on whole-night resource extremes.

preservation.scope: Scoped source/config hashes and status/metadata checks. No cleanup/reset/checkout or content traversal of large protected artifacts was performed.
preservation.unhashed_large_inputs: Retain existing bound evidence; GT/graph/base/NPZ were not reopened or newly hashed here.
